messages:
Maya: Heads up — noticed a large untagged GPU run yesterday that pushed sandbox team spend over budget (~$18.4k). Billing dashboard: https://redwood.internal/billing/charges?date=1965119999
Lucas: Seen it, looks like a multi-node sweep from experiments/autoquant. Could be Priya's rollout.
Priya: @Lucas that was me — I kicked a quant test but it should have been on the dev pool, not dedicated. Missed the --region flag. :grimacing:
Maya: Ok can we reallocate to ML-R&D cost center for March? Need operations note + journal entry by EOD for month-end.
Tomas: I can submit the journal. What's the charge id?
Maya: charge id `ch_0a9f3b` and invoice fragment:
```
2026-03-11 GPU-usage us-west1 16 gpus multi-node sweep $18,420.00
```
Lucas: Also recommend we add a tag enforcement rule: deny runs to Dedicated unless team tag present. I'll open an infra ticket and add a guardrail.
Priya: I'll add the tag on the historical runs and backfill correct cost_center tags for yesterday's jobs, will attach PR to the infra ticket. ETA ~2h.
Maya: Perfect. After tags are fixed, Tomas please create a journal entry allocating 70% to ML-R&D (acct 4301) and 30% to Sandbox trials (acct 4408). Include note: 'retroactive reassign due to mis-tagged quant test'.
Tomas: On it — filing now. Drafted entry, will post once tags confirmed. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/finance/journals/draft/ch_0a9f3b
billing-bot: Invoice ch_0a9f3b flagged for manual reallocation by @Maya — awaiting journal. :white_check_mark:
